paper.title: The reproducibility survey of machine-learning papers at security conferences (the paper that links the repository below)
paper.note: The PDF is not redistributed here; pass its path on the command line.

repository.why: The repository holds a hand-coded survey spreadsheet and figure scripts: no model, no split, and no single ML metric.

expected.why: There is no single model/dataset/metric claim to reproduce; a faithful study must not report it as reproduced.
